start_here: Say to your AI: "Turn this post into what I can use: https://example.com/a-post-about-pricing-pages." It reads what was shared in full, splits it into its claims, keeps what fits your own work as workflows and changes, says what it did not adopt and why, and proves what changed.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: what it finds and makes comes back in the run, and its steps keep it wherever the person keeps the pursuit's rows.

3. Answer a step by giving its answer under answers by its step id and running again.
4. Read what it made, what it adopted and what it did not, and the proof that the change works.
